terminalCliCommands: kicad-terminal completion          generate shell completion script
kicad-terminal acp                 start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server
kicad-terminal mcp                 manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
kicad-terminal [project]           start kicad terminal                                  [default]
kicad-terminal attach <url>        attach to a running kicad server
kicad-terminal run [message..]     run kicad with a message
kicad-terminal debug               debugging and troubleshooting tools
kicad-terminal providers           manage AI providers and credentials             [aliases: auth]
kicad-terminal agent               manage agents
kicad-terminal upgrade [target]    upgrade the kicad runtime to the latest or a specific version
kicad-terminal uninstall           uninstall the kicad runtime and remove all related files
kicad-terminal serve               starts a headless kicad server
kicad-terminal web                 start kicad server and open web interface
kicad-terminal models [provider]   list all available models
kicad-terminal stats               show token usage and cost statistics
kicad-terminal export [sessionID]  export session data as JSON
kicad-terminal import <file>       import session data from JSON file
kicad-terminal github              manage GitHub agent
kicad-terminal pr <number>         fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run kicad
kicad-terminal session             manage sessions
kicad-terminal plugin <module>     install plugin and update config                [aliases: plug]
kicad-terminal db                  database tools
